text_block_list.text:
The day after Nishino Flower took a day 
off, while having a meeting with her—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
............Ah! I-I'm so sorry! Just now, 
I—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Au... I'm so sorry... I woke up from a 
scary dream yesterday... and couldn't get 
much sleep after that...—

It seems Nishino Flower wasn't able to 
rest very well because she had a scary 
dream...
